row.body: The cabin key is tied to a trail map and a note to leave no litter. The checkout sheet says the guests left before the caretaker reached the road.
row.title: Cabin rules after dark

sidecar.gloss: The guests depart before the caretaker reaches the cabin road.
sidecar.rival_reading: A visitor could leave early for ordinary reasons; the sheet does not show why the caretaker was delayed.
